spanish: Y rodeará a ustedes el límite desde el Neguev a Maalé Aqrabim, y pasará a Tsin, y serán sus salidas desde el Neguev a Qadesh Barnéa, y saldrá a Hatsar Adar, y pasará a Atsmoná.

findings.issue: Niphal 3ms of H5437 turns or is turned; לָכֶם is to or for you. «rodeará a ustedes» makes the border surround the addressees.
H5045 is a common noun (south / south-country / Negeb), not a proper name. «Neguev» leaves it untranslated and closes the open sense as a place name.
לְמַעֲלֵה is a common noun in construct (ascent of); only עַקְרַבִּים is the proper name. «Maalé» is an untranslated common noun fused into the name.
Verbless clause (its outgoings from … to …). «y serán» adds an unmarked conjunction and an unmarked future copula.
H5045 is again a common noun left untranslated as the place name «Neguev».
חֲצַר אַדָּר has no preposition and no directional suffix. «a» is supplied so salir can take the place; Tsin and Atsmon are the tokens that mark direction.
The directional suffix is already carried by «a»; «Atsmoná» also keeps that he in the name.

notes: Plural salidas, 3ms border verbs, and ustedes for the 2mp suffix match the tokens.
